description: Manage Figma connector integrations — list connected files or trigger a sync to pull design tokens, components, and page structure into your Contextium libraries.

action.description: list: show all connected Figma files and their sync status; sync: trigger a full sync for a specific connection

integrationId.description: Integration ID of the Figma connection to sync (required for action=sync). Get this from action=list.

name: figma_sync
